f.n: Humber Estuary- Spurn Point Seagrass Area
f.pu: To protect important seagrass beds, a protected sub-feature of the Humber Estuary European Marine Site, and to ensure that the North Eastern IFCA is meeting its statutory duties in accordance with the Conservation of Habitats and Species Regulations 2010.
f.re: The following is prohibited: 1. Digging or using any pots, traps, nets (whether or not fixed or anchored to the seabed), trawls, dredges or similar devices within the specified area. 2. Taking any sea fisheries resources from the specified area.
f.rn: North Eastern Inshore Fisheries and Conservation Authority XXIX Humber Estuary Fishing Byelaw

f.n: Loch Sunart to the Sound of Jura
f.d: Nature Conservation MPA; OSPAR Marine Protected Area
f.pu: To safeguard marine habitats and wildlife while supporting a range of commercial and recreation activities based on the principles of sustainable use. This site was designated to facilitate the very differing management, monitoring and surveying requirements of conserving common skate at this MPA.
f.re: 1. A person must not deploy (by any means) or use any fishing gear within the protected area, subject to exceptions in the subareas. 2. While a fishing vessel is within the protected area the master of the vessel must ensure that any fishing gear carried on board the vessel is properly lashed and stowed in such a way that it may not be readily used, subject to exceptions in the subareas.
f.rn: The Loch Sunart to the Sound of Jura Marine Conservation Order 2016
